[#asio-example-matrix]
=== Current maintained-example matrix

This table covers the nine maintained Asio guide programs, not every original Boost.Asio application. Each `pass` is a fresh Release build followed by an exact `.expected` output comparison. Emscripten observations here run in Node; the real-browser scheduling and worker tests are separate. The Cobalt alias is covered by the Cobalt application matrix.

`n/a` means this particular example demonstrates an interface belonging to another target. It is not a failed test. `SDK` records absent P2 pthread or P3 cooperative exception support in wasi-sdk 34. The browser socket example deliberately verifies `operation_not_supported` for raw TCP; the browser resolver preserves the hostname for a host transport rather than performing guest DNS. The TLS example constructs and validates a trust context; it does not itself exchange TLS traffic.

The 92 successful executions retain commands, log hashes and implementation snapshots in the accompanying application evidence. No remote CI result is inferred.
